headline: Three unbeaten sides win eight from eight
dek: AUM, Trevecca and UAH have won all eight matches they have played between them, and AUM's first trip away from home ended the same way as the two at home. Below them, Delta State's win at Harding is the only one any other programme has, and Christian Brothers and Union have lost every match they have played.
displaced_by: Outside record is now 9-4-8, so the conference no longer wins as often as it loses; the Sep 2 sweep took the unbeaten trio to eight wins from eight.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The scoring at the top is not one striker's doing: UAH's eight goals have come from seven different players.

wire.line: UAH have scored more goals than Christian Brothers, Delta State, Union, Lee and Spring Hill have between them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lee have no match on the record before conference play opens, played or still to come: the first listed for them is the conference visit to AUM.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: The record's silences are all of the same kind: six matches have passed their date with no result at all, the latest Spring Hill's opener at Mobile, and no final has been left without a score.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Mississippi Christian have two matches on the record and no box score for either: the results are published, the detail behind them is not.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Christian Brothers have conceded seven goals, more than any other programme has let in.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hunter Walker has kept clean sheets in two of Trevecca's three matches.

last_match.line: AUM's first trip away from home ended as every match at home had, and they remain unbeaten.

next_match.line: UAH have already won away from home, at Illinois Springfield, and have yet to concede at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
